rows.label: bulwark picture: fighter fields
rows.why: The picture's own state on the fighter (the bar folds past ultWall; a block's flash and an arrow's scorch outlive their step, and a stopped arrow is spliced before the picture can see it); never m.ultFx (open item 25). Read by nothing in the sim.

rows.label: bulwark picture: the presentation call
rows.why: tickPresentation runs through hit stops and after the match; one call to tickBulwark.

rows.label: bulwark picture: tickBulwark
rows.why: Drives the bar (rise at the cast, hold, fold 0.25s off ultWall && alive && !over) and finds each block and arrow by wallTally rising: a block flashes the bar for 2 frames; an arrow leaves a scorch at its place along the bar (from the shots' predicted positions, kept as plain numbers); a bank floats the vigil '+N' on the caster and, once a window, tags WARD. Writes presentation fields, floats, tags and taught only; no rng.

rows.label: bulwark picture: the world call (over both fighters)
rows.why: World pass, after both fighters: the wall stands in front of the sword and the ward ring, with every ball's disc cut out of it (CLAUDE.md 4.1b); bloom share 0.

rows.label: bulwark picture: the drawing methods
rows.why: drawBulwark and one method a component (halo, motes, body with the block flash, scorch), the bar rebuilt from the sim's own geometry at draw time and blended into the ward ring's arc for the rise and the fold.

                 record falls to the map's own 1.5 and carries the CAST only -- no
                 set-piece draws from it; the wall is drawn off the fighter. */

fx_spec:
NONE. The design's "Field: motes along the bar, both copies" is DRAWN in the world pass (_bulwarkMotes: 10 motes, 1s life, drifting off both faces of the bar, placed by shellHash, no rng). An fx.js spec cannot carry it. Measured with lk_fxprobe.py over 145 Bulwark windows (16 foes x 2 seeds, both sides). A SPECS field fires once, at the cast, from the one m.ultFx slot. That slot was Lightkeeper's at the cast in 121 of 145 windows; in the other 24 the foe's same-step cast took it (both charges are 14). It then held the slot for a median 0.64s (max 0.72s) of the 8s window clock, so a slot-borne field could exist for 7.3% of the window. Once the slot is gone, the bar's centre is a median 181 units from the cast point (p10 66, p90 370), and the bar turns a median 7.59 rad per window. Zenith and Canopy measured the same thing and drew their motes. RETIRE the nova's burst from BOTH copies (fx_remove.py --relic lightkeeper, as for Ironhail). Exact text of the entry in the base's inlined copy:
    lightkeeper: { mode: 'burst', n: 1500, sp: [210, 560], grav: 70,
                   drag: 2.5, life: [0.35, 0.85], heavy: 0.03,
                   size: [0.8, 2.2], spawn: 0.05, up: 0 },
In scratch, taking it out of the inlined copy moves the inlined module sha from 28fc58641370a1a9 to a74732c13d4bae1b (page lk-final-fx.html 5acd4d78b30b6914). The page is safe without it, and every gate below ran on that spec-out page. I did not touch src/render/fx.js.

Resumed from the cut-off attempt. I re-ran the cheap checks: base hash, rows == builder, stamp, order and carry. I kept m2, the probe, verify, render_ab, the silhouette and the Electron frame cost, which all ran on these exact bytes. I then finished what was missing:

In the repo I wrote only the sheet. The app json, fx.js, 02-chain and git are untouched.

THE SIM: no sim edits. All picture state is on the fighter (bulwarkFade/Age/Out/Flash/Seen/Shots/Scorch/Tagged). tickBulwark runs in tickPresentation and finds blocks and arrows by watching wallTally rise, so tickLightwall and the cast have no new call. That is why probe v5 passes 8/8 with no allow-list change. The only match state it writes is presentation: floats, tags and taught.ward (the vigil branch's own teaching path). Nothing in the sim reads them, which engine_ab, verify and shell identity confirm.

READINGS DECLARED (art and sound are Code's picks; Rick overrules):
(1) "Vertical bar" = the wall's own line, perpendicular to theta, rebuilt at draw time from u.ahead and u.half. It swings with the blade.
(2) Rise 0.25s: smoothstep from the ward ring's front arc (R+17, one plate wide round the facing) to the straight 220-unit bar. The ring front lights at alpha 0.4 at once. With no ward up it still rises from R+17.
(3) Fold 0.25s: the rise mirrored. It keys on ultWall -> null, the caster's death, or m.over.
(4) The block flash is "2 frames": 0.033s, white source-over on the body and heart. A contact while the bar is still rising snaps it up (Canopy's sprout rule).
(5) The "+3" float is the vigil branch's own float on the caster. It fires for arrow banks too, since both bank (v77: "+3 ward per block (ball or arrow)"). It shows the real banked amount, so a capped shield floats nothing.
(6) The WARD tag once a window is my own addition, the same tag and first-time tip the vigil branch uses.
(7) Scorch 0.3s: a char mark in _stWard's edge colour #1A0512, placed along the bar where the arrow died, with a white strike ring for the first 0.12s. An arrow loosed and stopped inside one step is placed at the foe's bow tip (spawnShot's R + reach).
(8) Halo: 14 units a side, three stacked strokes, no shadowBlur or bloom.
(9) Every live ball's disc (a, b, shades) is clipped out at 0.98R (4.1b).
(10) Retired: the nova's under/over branches and the life-map 1.5 entry (the map default is also 1.5, so no change). ULTSIG.lightkeeper is redrawn: five ward plates, a bar that rises with the charge, and an arrow stopped against it.
(11) Silhouette unchanged: it reads mid-row.
